newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin sacks deputy defence minister Kobets.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin sacks deputy defence minister Kobets.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin has sacked a once loyal ally, General Konstantin Kobets, from the posts of deputy defence minister and chief military inspector, Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Tuesday.

Military prosecutors have brought charges of bribe-taking, embezzlement and illegal posession of arms against Kobets, who played a vital role in backing Yeltsin during a hardline coup attempt in 1991 and a revolt in 1993.
Yastrzhembsky also said that Yeltsin, who is commander-in-chief of the Russian armed forces, had sacked Kobets from the military service.
Kobets, 57, whom Yeltsin made defence minister in 1991 for a brief period, was in hospital. He earlier denied all charges against him.
Yeltsin and his new reformist government launched an anti-corruption drive last week, promising to cleanse the state of dishonest officials.
